info.name: Service Request Management API
info.description:
Complete collection for the Service Request Management API.

HOW TO USE
1. Set the `baseUrl` variable (default http://localhost:5000).
2. Run `01 Auth > Signup` (or Login). Both the access token and the refresh
   token are saved to collection variables automatically.
3. Run `03 Requests > Create Request`. The generated requestId is saved too.
4. Everything else reuses those variables, so you can press Run and execute
   the whole suite top to bottom.

Auth is set at collection level (Bearer {{accessToken}}) and switched off only
on the public endpoints.

Tip: `npm run seed` first if you want the filtering and pagination folders to
return interesting data.
